items.text: In the Claude app's sidebar, open the two sessions "LEDGER: read back page answers (nightly)" and "LEDGER: fresh-session test (once)"; where either waits on a permission question, choose to always allow it; where one shows no question, press Stop.
items.recommendation: Allow: both only read (your page answers; the project's files). A scheduled session stops at its first question with nobody there, which has blocked the nightly read-back since 26 October; an answer given once is kept for its later runs. There is no web link for a session; both are in the app's sidebar.

items.text: May I make a fourth try at Tom's collar, with the zip worn about 6 cm lower so the collar's front stands open and his chin falls between its tips when he looks down?
items.recommendation: Yes: measured this morning, his chin and jaw come through the collar's top front from 10 degrees down; a shape that pushes the collar out would have to flare it 52 mm into a funnel, and hiding skin cannot work because the skin that crosses shows above the collar. Many 1990 blousons were worn open at the neck. The other choice is to leave it as a known fault.
